context: A mom rushes her young son to get ready for school
purpose: Teach: なくっ/さっさと/あたかも/ともあれ/おかしな/らしき/あまりの/有難う

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、さっさと起きなさい！もう七時よ！
lines.en: Sho, get up right now! It's already seven!
lines.style: Sharp urgent maternal scolding with rising volume

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うぅ…おかしな夢見てたんだもん…
lines.en: Ughh... I was having a weird dream though...
lines.style: Sleepy whining child voice trailing off groggily

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そんなに寝てたら学校に遅刻するわよ！早く行かなくっちゃ！
lines.en: If you sleep that long you'll be late for school! We have to go!
lines.style: Frantic mother rushing words together breathlessly fast

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、玄関から先生らしき声が聞こえるんだけど…
lines.en: Mom, I can hear what sounds like the teacher at the door...
lines.style: Confused sleepy child innocently observing something strange

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あたかも他人事みたいに言わないで！ともあれ顔洗ってきて！
lines.en: Don't talk like it has nothing to do with you! Anyway, go wash your face!
lines.style: Exasperated mother snapping with theatrical frustration loudly

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: はーい…ねえママ、お弁当は？
lines.en: Okaaay... Hey Mom, what about my lunch?
lines.style: Reluctant compliant drag followed by lazy whining question

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日はコンビニのおにぎりで我慢して！あまりの遅さに私まで遅刻しちゃう！
lines.en: Just put up with a convenience-store rice ball today! You're so slow I'll be late too!
lines.style: Machine-gun delivery harried multitasking mother tone exasperated

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: わかった、ママごめん…行ってきます、有難う！
lines.en: Got it, sorry Mom... I'm off, thanks!
lines.style: Softening apologetic child gradually shifting into grateful goodbye
